answer: An admission auction prices entry: to join the terrace, each applicant posts a sealed bid plus a deposit worth twice 30 days of earnings. Top bidders win the slots, and each deposit locks for 20 epochs. A sybil wanting 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times: at 600 POA each that is 60,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and keeps the echo of its good record. Each bid is a sonnet: short, fixed, signed, so copies are rejected.
